story.text: 출국 게이트 앞, 규현은 평소와 다르게 말이 없었다. 캐리어 손잡이를 괜히 만지작거리기만 했다.
story.reading: chul-guk ge-i-teu ap, gyu-hyeon-eun pyeong-so-wa da-reu-ge mal-i eop-seot-da. kae-ri-eo son-jab-i-reul gwaen-hi man-ji-jak-geo-ri-gi-man haet-da.
story.en: In front of the departure gate, Kyuhyun was unusually quiet. He just kept fidgeting with the suitcase handle for no reason.

story.text: "이제 진짜 가는 거예요?" 그가 헛기침을 하며 물었다. "그래서, 다음엔 또 언제 와요?"
story.reading: "i-je jin-jja ga-neun geo-ye-yo?" geu-ga heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo mul-eot-da. "geu-rae-seo, da-eum-en tto eon-je wa-yo?"
story.en: "So you're really leaving now?" he asked, clearing his throat. "So? When are you coming back next?"

story.text: "글쎄, 다음엔 규현 씨가 저 보러 올 차례 아니에요?" 내가 장난스레 받아치자 그는 피식 웃었다.
story.reading: "geul-sse, da-eum-en gyu-hyeon ssi-ga jeo bo-reo ol cha-lye a-ni-e-yo?" nae-ga jang-nan-seu-re bad-a-chi-ja geu-neun pi-sik us-eot-da.
story.en: "Well, isn't it your turn to come see me next time?" I shot back playfully, and he let out a short laugh.

story.text: "저야 좋죠. 근데 그전까지는 이 우정, 변치 않는 거예요." 그가 새끼손가락을 내밀며 진지한 얼굴로 말했다.
story.reading: "jeo-ya jo-chyo. geun-de geu-jeon-kka-ji-neun i u-jeong, byeon-chi an-neun geo-ye-yo." geu-ga sae-kki-son-ga-rag-eul nae-mil-myeo jin-ji-han eol-gul-lo mal-haet-da.
story.en: "I'd love that. But until then, this friendship of ours doesn't change, got it?" He held out his pinky finger, his expression suddenly serious.

story.text: 나는 웃으며 그의 손가락에 내 손가락을 걸었다. "당연하지. 우리 우정은 평생 갈 거야."
story.reading: na-neun us-eu-myeo geu-ui son-ga-rag-e nae son-ga-rag-eul geol-eot-da. "dang-yeon-ha-ji. u-ri u-jeong-eun pyeong-saeng gal geo-ya."
story.en: Smiling, I hooked my pinky around his. "Of course. Our friendship's going to last a lifetime."

story.text: "능글맞은 소리만 하는 줄 알았더니, 가끔은 이렇게 진심도 보여주네요." 내가 놀리듯 말하자 그는 또 헛기침을 했다.
story.reading: "neung-geul-maj-eun so-ri-man ha-neun jul al-at-deo-ni, ga-kkeum-eun i-reoh-ge jin-sim-do bo-yeo-ju-ne-yo." nae-ga nol-li-deut mal-ha-ja geu-neun tto heot-gi-chim-eul haet-da.
story.en: "I thought all you ever did was talk smooth, but every once in a while you actually show some real sincerity." I teased, and he cleared his throat again.

story.text: "제가 원래 이래요. 평생 이 자리에서 아가씨 든든하게 지켜 줄 사람이니까." 그가 어깨를 으쓱하며 여유롭게 웃었다.
story.reading: "je-ga won-lae i-rae-yo. pyeong-saeng i ja-ri-e-seo a-ga-ssi deun-deun-ha-ge ji-kyeo jul sa-ram-i-ni-kka." geu-ga eo-kkae-reul eu-sseuk-ha-myeo yeo-yu-rob-ge us-eot-da.
story.en: "That's just how I am. Because I'll always be the reliable guy standing right here, watching over you, miss." He shrugged, laughing easily.

story.text: 게이트 너머로 사라지기 직전, 나는 뒤돌아 크게 손을 흔들었다. "또 보자, 규현아!" 그의 웃음소리가 오래도록 귓가에 맴돌았다. 우리의 우정은, 어디에 있든 영원히 변하지 않을 것 같았다.
story.reading: ge-i-teu neo-meo-ro sa-ra-ji-gi jik-jeon, na-neun dwi-dol-a keu-ge son-eul heun-deul-eot-da. "tto bo-ja, gyu-hyeon-a!" geu-ui us-eum-so-ri-ga o-rae-do-rok gwis-ga-e maem-dol-at-da. u-ri-ui u-jeong-eun, eo-di-e it-deun yeong-won-hi byeon-ha-ji an-eul geot gat-at-da.
story.en: Just before disappearing beyond the gate, I turned back and waved big. "See you again, Kyuhyun!" The sound of his laughter lingered in my ears for a long time after. Our friendship, I felt, would stay unchanged forever, no matter where each of us ended up.

words.example_en: Let's not let our friendship change.
This is how I truly feel.
I'll never forget this kindness as long as I live.
I feel reassured when he's by my side.

sentences.en: Let's not let our friendship change.
I won't be able to forget it for the rest of my life.
I feel really reassured when he's around.
